parameters.name: LoadMapResourcesAndGeometry
parameters.comment: Original BBDX_MapManager::Load(CString). Open-check the path; read required GRS indices, reuse/load graphics and surfaces, call LoadMap, and reset visible sprite cache. No UserUnit creation call is present in this function.
